title: "Single Stock View"

```{python}
# | tags: [setup]
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import board
import charts
from board import HELP, SETUP_CHECKS, tip

px_all, meta, M = board.load()

# Order tickers by group so the arrow keys walk the watchlist first, then the
# ETFs and benchmarks — the same "universe nav" idea as the Streamlit viewer.
GROUP_ORDER = ["watchlist", "etf", "index", "dashboard"]
TICKERS = [t for g in GROUP_ORDER
           for t in sorted(M[M["group"] == g].index) if t in M.index]
```

```{python}
def num(s):
    """Round for transport; JSON can't carry NaN, so nulls become gaps.

    2dp because these are prices — more digits just inflate the payload every
    visitor downloads.
    """
    return [None if pd.isna(v) else round(float(v), 2) for v in s]


def build_payload():
    """Per-ticker candles at all three timeframes, plus the metrics row.

    The whole universe ships with the page. A static site can't query for a
    ticker on demand, and swapping a preloaded series is instant — the point of
    arrow-key nav is flipping through names without waiting.
    """
    out = {}
    for tk in TICKERS:
        g = px_all[px_all["ticker"] == tk]
        tf = {}
        for label, rule, bars in charts.TIMEFRAMES:
            f = charts.timeframe_frame(g, rule, bars)
            # Moving averages are derived in the browser rather than shipped:
            # they were 3 of 7 arrays and a rolling mean is five lines of JS.
            tf[label[0].lower()] = {
                "x": [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for d in f["date"]],
                "o": num(f["open"]), "h": num(f["high"]),
                "l": num(f["low"]), "c": num(f["close"]),
            }
        r = M.loc[tk]

        def val(key, scale=1.0):
            v = r.get(key)
            return None if pd.isna(v) else round(float(v) * scale, 4)

        out[tk] = {
            "tf": tf,
            "group": r["group"],
            "stats": {
                "close": val("close"), "ret_1d": val("ret_1d", 100),
                "ret_1w": val("ret_1w", 100), "ret_1m": val("ret_1m", 100),
                "rs_1m": val("rs_1m"), "rs_3m": val("rs_3m"),
                "rsi": val("rsi"), "atr_ext": val("atr_ext"),
                "pct_off_52w": val("pct_off_52w"), "adr": val("adr", 100),
                "rel_vol": val("rel_vol"),
            },
            "setup": [
                {"label": label, "ok": (None if ok is None else bool(ok))}
                for (label, _), ok in zip(SETUP_CHECKS, r["setup_results"])
            ],
        }
    return out


PAYLOAD = build_payload()
size_kb = len(json.dumps(PAYLOAD, separators=(",", ":")).encode()) / 1024
Markdown(f"<p class='stamp'>Last bar **{meta['last_bar']}** · {len(TICKERS)} tickers "
         f"· ← → to switch · {size_kb:,.0f} KB preloaded</p>")
```

```{python}
options = "".join(f'<option value="{t}">{t}</option>' for t in TICKERS)
tf_btns = "".join(
    f'<button type="button" data-tf="{label[0].lower()}"'
    f'{" class=\"active\"" if i == 0 else ""}>{label}</button>'
    for i, (label, _, _) in enumerate(charts.TIMEFRAMES))

controls = f"""
<div class="ssv-controls">
  <button type="button" id="ssv-prev" aria-label="Previous ticker">◀</button>
  <select id="ssv-ticker" aria-label="Ticker">{options}</select>
  <button type="button" id="ssv-next" aria-label="Next ticker">▶</button>
  <span class="stamp" id="ssv-pos"></span>
</div>
<div class="tf-switch" id="ssv-tf" role="group" aria-label="Candle timeframe">{tf_btns}</div>
<div class="stat-strip" id="ssv-stats"></div>
<div id="ssv-setup" class="setup-chips"></div>
"""
HTML(controls)
```

```{python}
# Rendered server-side so Quarto ships plotly.js; the script then drives it.
charts.candle_figure(px_all[px_all["ticker"] == TICKERS[0]], TICKERS[0], height=430).show(
    config={"responsive": True, "displayModeBar": False})
```

```{python}
SCRIPT = r"""
<script>
(function () {
  var DATA = __PAYLOAD__;
  var TICKERS = __TICKERS__;
  var COLORS = {ma10: "#3498db", ma20: "#e67e22", ma50: "#9b59b6"};
  var idx = 0, tf = "d";

  var sel = document.getElementById("ssv-ticker");
  var pos = document.getElementById("ssv-pos");
  var statsEl = document.getElementById("ssv-stats");
  var setupEl = document.getElementById("ssv-setup");
  var tfHost = document.getElementById("ssv-tf");

  function chart() {
    var all = document.querySelectorAll(".plotly-graph-div");
    for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      if (tfHost.compareDocumentPosition(all[i]) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING) {
        return all[i];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function fmtSigned(v, dp, suffix) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return '<span class="stamp">—</span>';
    var cls = v >= 0 ? "up" : "down";
    return '<span class="' + cls + '">' + (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(dp) +
           (suffix === undefined ? "%" : suffix) + "</span>";
  }
  function fmtNum(v, dp) {
    return (v === null || v === undefined) ? "—" : v.toFixed(dp);
  }

  function renderStats(d) {
    var s = d.stats;
    var cards = [
      ["Close", fmtNum(s.close, 2), ""],
      ["1D", fmtSigned(s.ret_1d, 2), ""],
      ["1M", fmtSigned(s.ret_1m, 2), ""],
      ["RS 1M", fmtSigned(s.rs_1m, 1), ""],
      ["RSI", fmtNum(s.rsi, 0), ""],
      ["ATR ext", fmtNum(s.atr_ext, 1), ""],
      ["Off 52w hi", fmtSigned(s.pct_off_52w, 1), ""],
      ["Rel vol", fmtNum(s.rel_vol, 2), ""]
    ];
    statsEl.innerHTML = cards.map(function (c) {
      return '<div class="stat"><div class="label">' + c[0] +
             '</div><div class="value">' + c[1] + "</div></div>";
    }).join("");

    var passed = d.setup.filter(function (c) { return c.ok; }).length;
    setupEl.innerHTML =
      '<span class="setup-score ' + (passed >= 5 ? "up" : (passed <= 2 ? "down" : "")) +
      '">' + passed + "/6</span>" +
      d.setup.map(function (c) {
        var cls = c.ok === null ? "na" : (c.ok ? "ok" : "no");
        var mark = c.ok === null ? "–" : (c.ok ? "✓" : "✗");
        return '<span class="chip ' + cls + '">' + mark + " " + c.label + "</span>";
      }).join("");
  }

  // Rolling mean over the timeframe's own closes, so a 10-period MA on the
  // weekly chart is 10 weeks — same rule the server-rendered charts follow.
  function sma(arr, n) {
    var out = [], sum = 0, q = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      var v = arr[i];
      if (v === null) { out.push(null); continue; }
      q.push(v); sum += v;
      if (q.length > n) sum -= q.shift();
      out.push(q.length === n ? sum / n : null);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function traces(d) {
    var f = d.tf[tf];
    var out = [{
      type: "candlestick", x: f.x, open: f.o, high: f.h, low: f.l, close: f.c,
      increasing: {line: {color: "#18bc9c"}}, decreasing: {line: {color: "#e74c3c"}},
      name: TICKERS[idx], showlegend: false
    }];
    [10, 20, 50].forEach(function (n) {
      out.push({
        type: "scatter", mode: "lines", x: f.x, y: sma(f.c, n),
        name: "SMA" + n, line: {color: COLORS["ma" + n], width: n === 50 ? 1.4 : 1.0}
      });
    });
    return out;
  }

  function render() {
    var tk = TICKERS[idx], d = DATA[tk], gd = chart();
    sel.value = tk;
    pos.textContent = (idx + 1) + " / " + TICKERS.length + " · " + d.group;
    renderStats(d);
    if (!gd || typeof Plotly === "undefined") return;
    // Weekend gaps only exist on the daily axis.
    var layout = {
      height: 430, margin: {l: 8, r: 8, t: 34, b: 26}, template: "plotly_white",
      xaxis: {rangeslider: {visible: false},
              rangebreaks: tf === "d" ? [{bounds: ["sat", "mon"]}] : []},
      yaxis: {side: "right"},
      legend: {orientation: "h", y: 1.0, yanchor: "bottom", x: 0, xanchor: "left",
               font: {size: 11}}
    };
    Plotly.react(gd, traces(d), layout, {responsive: true, displayModeBar: false});
  }

  function move(step) {
    idx = (idx + step + TICKERS.length) % TICKERS.length;
    render();
  }

  document.getElementById("ssv-prev").addEventListener("click", function () { move(-1); });
  document.getElementById("ssv-next").addEventListener("click", function () { move(1); });
  sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
    var i = TICKERS.indexOf(sel.value);
    if (i >= 0) { idx = i; render(); }
  });
  tfHost.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
    var b = ev.target.closest("button[data-tf]");
    if (!b) return;
    tf = b.dataset.tf;
    tfHost.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("active"); });
    b.classList.add("active");
    render();
  });
  // Arrow keys, unless the user is typing in a field.
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
    var t = ev.target.tagName;
    if (t === "INPUT" || t === "TEXTAREA" || t === "SELECT") return;
    if (ev.key === "ArrowLeft") { move(-1); ev.preventDefault(); }
    if (ev.key === "ArrowRight") { move(1); ev.preventDefault(); }
  });

  var tries = 0;
  (function start() {
    if ((!chart() || typeof Plotly === "undefined") && tries++ < 100) {
      return setTimeout(start, 60);
    }
    render();
  })();
})();
</script>
"""
HTML(SCRIPT
     .replace("__PAYLOAD__", json.dumps(PAYLOAD, separators=(",", ":")))
     .replace("__TICKERS__", json.dumps(TICKERS)))
```
